content.text:
I fixed the bug with a one-line change in `solution/core.py`, and both visible tests now pass. `wrap_text` was splitting the input into paragraphs at blank lines correctly, but then joining the wrapped paragraphs back together with a single `"
"`. That dropped the blank line between them, so separate paragraphs ran together. I changed the final join to `"

"`, which puts one blank line between paragraphs. Several blank lines in a row still collapse to one, which is what the existing test expects. I didn't change how lines containing only spaces are handled: they are still not treated as paragraph breaks, which is how the code already behaved.
